findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure gRPC channel usage
 * @description Using insecure_channel() without SSL/TLS can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-grpc-channel
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("grpc").getMember(["insecure_channel"]).getACall()
select call, "Insecure gRPC channel created without SSL/TLS. Consider using secure_channel() with proper credentials."
findings.hypothesis: Finding insecure gRPC channel usage which could lead to man-in-the-middle attacks

message.text: Insecure gRPC channel created without SSL/TLS. Consider using secure_channel() with proper credentials.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in gRPC
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle, yaml, or other unsafe methods
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization operations could allow code execution
